buyModifier.label: Buy Modifier
buyModifier.hint: Percentage adjustment applied to item prices in this shop's Buy tab. Negative values lower the price, positive values raise it. Individual items can override this.

sellModifier.label: Sell Modifier
sellModifier.hint: Percentage adjustment applied to item prices in this shop's Sell tab. Negative values lower the price, positive values raise it.

fixedValueLootTypes.label: Fixed-Value Item Types
fixedValueLootTypes.hint: Loot subtypes never subject to the Buy/Sell modifiers above (e.g. gemstones, art objects always sell at their listed value).

uuid.label: UUID
uuid.hint: Alternative to the browser above — paste or drop an item UUID directly, useful for world items in no compendium.

allowFreeformMaterials.label: Allow Freeform Materials
allowFreeformMaterials.hint: Players may substitute any item of sufficient value for the fixed materials below.

unlockedFor.label: Unlocked For
unlockedFor.hint: Actors who may start this craft. Ignored if "Open to All" is checked.

openToAll.label: Open to All
openToAll.hint: Any player may start this craft, regardless of the list above.

materialPrice.label: Material Price
materialPrice.hint: Required value of the selected materials. Leave empty to use the rules-based value for the target item.

allowWorkshopOverride.label: Allow Workshop Override
allowWorkshopOverride.hint: Players can claim access to a proper workshop instead of owning the required tool.

value.label: Duration Override
value.hint: Leave empty to use the rules-based duration for the target item.
